messages:
ash: Heads-up: syncing HW vendor launch lanes (H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi). Need non-overlap for marketplace GA, SI demos, and press. Quick volunteers?

morgan: I can map marketplace quotas by region. Will post numbers by EOD.

riley: SI partners asking for exclusive demo days; recommend reserving 1/day/vendor where possible.

samir: Ops: we should define fallback images and an automated route policy when latency >350ms for 3m. I can prototype.

announce-bot: New doc: https://redwood.company/docs/partners/hw-announce-orch - reviewers: morgan, riley.

ash: Minor ask: flag any firmware or driver risks per region. Riley please confirm GAUDI driver sign-off in EU.

riley: Noted. There's a gaudi firmware window next week - marked as "firmware-risk" until sign-off.

morgan: Uploaded quota sheet. us-east H100 capacity ok; eu-central limited to 40% H100 reservations.

samir: I'll build fallback image tag `redwood/fallback:mi300-q1` and canary route. Target to validate by Fri.

ash: Action items: morgan quotas (EOD), riley confirm firmware (tomorrow), samir prototype route (Fri). Recon Thu morning.

morgan: Also recommend hard block for APAC publishing within 48h.

ash: Agreed. Thanks everyone. If anything slips >48h ping me and we'll escalate.
